decisions.reason: The source requires a reshoot, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting reshoot_required to true; script adherence remains owned by the source Requirement.
Requiring exact script delivery and a reshoot does not change the existing screen-tap confidence or timing requirements.
The source changes script adherence and requires refilming but does not alter the required filming setting or background.
The instruction to say every phrase exactly as written does not modify the separate opening performance of appearing to read the question from the phone.
Exact script adherence does not change the established requirement that the video be spoken in Arabic MSA.
The reshoot and script instruction does not change the candidate's delivery-channel state or reinstate the removed shared-link access attribute.
The source requires exact script delivery but does not explicitly modify or remove the existing below-one-minute duration limit.
